svg.title: Phase 5, Land: checks awaited, the base followed, failures repaired
svg.desc: After convergence the run decides the merge method, since an update follows it, asking you when the history is mixed; brings the branch up to date only when the forge reports it conflicting or behind a base that requires it, by a rebase with a leased push or a merge of the base, at most three times, handing conflicts to you or, under resolve, to the editor; and waits for the head's checks in slices under a wait budget kept on disk, rerunning a cancelled run once, running again while they are pending, and asking whether to extend when the budget is spent. A failed check under fix writes a digest for the editor, who diagnoses, posts a paragraph, repairs, and pushes; a repeated failure moves one lever, ci_fix_rounds caps the repairs, the check gate and a review of every file the repair touched follow, and the loop returns to the top until the checks pass.
svg.text: Between a clean ledger and the merge gate: the base keeps moving, and the checks have the last word.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script

text.tspan: ci-repair all rung base model inherit effort high reason ci-failed

g.text: the setting, else the one the repo
by the method, three times at most
waits in slices, budget on disk
a cancelled run is rerun once
the head passes; on to Merge
mixed history → you pick a method
one the repository allows; unattended, park
or, under resolve, the editor does
sync off, or the base keeps moving

svg.text: agent: a model with its own context
its model rung and effort, routed by a script
a fallback; the run goes on
stops or parks; a number is the exit code
